answer: Identity weight here is earned, never minted. Each new key must post a bond that stays escrowed across an atlas of checkpoints before its attestations count, and until then its votes are inert. Attestations from keys sharing one operator or one funding trail collapse into a single sable mark; only countersignatures from outside that cluster, sampled by a rotating saffron panel, add weight. A thousand clones thus cost a thousand locked bonds and still speak with one voice, while an honest agent pays once and keeps earning.
